perform: PERFORM OPEN-FILES IF FATAL-ERROR GOBACK END-IF PERFORM READ-POLICY PERFORM UNTIL PREM-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR PERFORM READ-PREMIUM IF NOT PREM-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR ADD 1 TO WS-READ PERFORM PROCESS-PREMIUM END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK.
PERFORM FIND-POLICY IF WS-POL-FOUND = 'Y' PERFORM VALIDATE-DATES ELSE MOVE 'E001' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'POLICY NOT FOUND FOR PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR END-IF.
PERFORM UNTIL POL-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF PI-POLICY-NO < PRI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-POLICY ELSE IF PI-POLICY-NO = PRI-POLICY-NO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM.

PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E002' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E003' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E006' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID PREMIUM CALCULATION DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'E004' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE PERFORM CALCULATE-EARNED END-IF END-IF END-IF END-IF.
PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID END-IF END-IF END-IF.
PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR IF WS-LEAP = 'Y' MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY ELSE MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY END-IF END-EVALUATE.

PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT < WS-EFF-INT MOVE ZERO TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT > WS-EXP-INT MOVE WS-TERM-DAYS TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE COMPUTE WS-EARNED-DAYS = WS-CALC-INT - WS-EFF-INT + 1 END-IF END-IF COMPUTE WS-EARNED ROUNDED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM * WS-EARNED-DAYS / WS-TERM-DAYS IF WS-EARNED > PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED END-IF COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM - WS-EARNED IF WS-UNEARNED < ZERO MOVE ZERO TO WS-UNEARNED END-IF PERFORM WRITE-RESULT END-IF.
read: READ PERFORM PROCESS-PREMIUM END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK.

READ POLICY-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-POLICY DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

READ PREMIUM-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PREM-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PRI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.
write: WRITE PRO-REC IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED ELSE DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
move: MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-POLICY DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PREM-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PRI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

MOVE 'N' TO WS-POL-FOUND PERFORM FIND-POLICY IF WS-POL-FOUND = 'Y' PERFORM VALIDATE-DATES ELSE MOVE 'E001' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'POLICY NOT FOUND FOR PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR END-IF.
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM.

MOVE PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E002' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E003' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E006' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID PREMIUM CALCULATION DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'E004' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE PERFORM CALCULATE-EARNED END-IF END-IF END-IF END-IF.

MOVE 'N' TO WS-DATE-VALID IF WS-DATE-IN NUMERIC MOVE WS-DATE-IN(1:4) TO WS-YEAR MOVE WS-DATE-IN(5:2) TO WS-MONTH MOVE WS-DATE-IN(7:2) TO WS-DAY IF WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12 PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID END-IF END-IF END-IF.
MOVE 31 TO WS-MAX-DAY WHEN 4 WHEN 6 WHEN 9 WHEN 11 MOVE 30 TO WS-MAX-DAY WHEN 2 PERFORM CHECK-LEAP-YEAR IF WS-LEAP = 'Y' MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY ELSE MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY END-IF END-EVALUATE.

MOVE 'N' TO WS-LEAP COMPUTE WS-REM4 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 4) COMPUTE WS-REM100 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 100) COMPUTE WS-REM400 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-YEAR, 400) IF WS-REM400 = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP ELSE IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP END-IF END-IF.

MOVE 'E005' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'POLICY TERM DAYS INVALID' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT < WS-EFF-INT MOVE ZERO TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT > WS-EXP-INT MOVE WS-TERM-DAYS TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE COMPUTE WS-EARNED-DAYS = WS-CALC-INT - WS-EFF-INT + 1 END-IF END-IF COMPUTE WS-EARNED ROUNDED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM * WS-EARNED-DAYS / WS-TERM-DAYS IF WS-EARNED > PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED END-IF COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM - WS-EARNED IF WS-UNEARNED < ZERO MOVE ZERO TO WS-UNEARNED END-IF PERFORM WRITE-RESULT END-IF.

MOVE PRI-PREMIUM-ID TO PRO-PREMIUM-ID MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO PRO-POLICY-NO MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO PRO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM MOVE WS-EARNED TO PRO-EARNED-PREMIUM MOVE WS-UNEARNED TO PRO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO PRO-CALCULATION-DATE WRITE PRO-REC IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED ELSE DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
open: OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN PREMIUM-IN OUTPUT PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'ERROR FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
display: DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK.

DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'ERROR FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.

DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-POLICY DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PRI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.
DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
if: IF FATAL-ERROR GOBACK END-IF PERFORM READ-POLICY PERFORM UNTIL PREM-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR PERFORM READ-PREMIUM IF NOT PREM-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR ADD 1 TO WS-READ PERFORM PROCESS-PREMIUM END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK.

IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY OPEN ERROR ' WS-PI-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OPEN ERROR ' WS-PR-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-PO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'OUTPUT OPEN ERROR ' WS-PO-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF IF WS-ER-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'ERROR FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-ER-ST SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.

IF NOT POL-EOF READ POLICY-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-POLICY DISPLAY 'POLICY INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

IF NOT PREM-EOF READ PREMIUM-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PREM-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PREMIUM READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PRI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.
IF WS-POL-FOUND = 'Y' PERFORM VALIDATE-DATES ELSE MOVE 'E001' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'POLICY NOT FOUND FOR PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR END-IF.
IF PI-POLICY-NO < PRI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-POLICY ELSE IF PI-POLICY-NO = PRI-POLICY-NO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM.

IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E002' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PI-EXPIRY-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E003' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE MOVE PRI-CALCULATION-DATE TO WS-DATE-IN PERFORM VALIDATE-CALENDAR-DATE IF WS-DATE-VALID NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'E006' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'INVALID PREMIUM CALCULATION DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF PI-EXPIRY-DATE < PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE MOVE 'E004' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE PERFORM CALCULATE-EARNED END-IF END-IF END-IF END-IF.

IF WS-DATE-IN NUMERIC MOVE WS-DATE-IN(1:4) TO WS-YEAR MOVE WS-DATE-IN(5:2) TO WS-MONTH MOVE WS-DATE-IN(7:2) TO WS-DAY IF WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12 PERFORM SET-MAX-DAY IF WS-DAY >= 1 AND WS-DAY <= WS-MAX-DAY MOVE 'Y' TO WS-DATE-VALID END-IF END-IF END-IF.
IF WS-LEAP = 'Y' MOVE 29 TO WS-MAX-DAY ELSE MOVE 28 TO WS-MAX-DAY END-IF END-EVALUATE.
IF WS-REM400 = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP ELSE IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LEAP END-IF END-IF.

IF WS-TERM-DAYS <= ZERO MOVE 'E005' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'POLICY TERM DAYS INVALID' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT < WS-EFF-INT MOVE ZERO TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE IF WS-CALC-INT > WS-EXP-INT MOVE WS-TERM-DAYS TO WS-EARNED-DAYS ELSE COMPUTE WS-EARNED-DAYS = WS-CALC-INT - WS-EFF-INT + 1 END-IF END-IF COMPUTE WS-EARNED ROUNDED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM * WS-EARNED-DAYS / WS-TERM-DAYS IF WS-EARNED > PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM MOVE PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED END-IF COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM - WS-EARNED IF WS-UNEARNED < ZERO MOVE ZERO TO WS-UNEARNED END-IF PERFORM WRITE-RESULT END-IF.
IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED ELSE DISPLAY 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-PO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE ERROR ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF.
add: ADD THEM WHEN APPROVED RULES ARE PROVIDED.

ADD 1 TO WS-READ PERFORM PROCESS-PREMIUM END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'EARNPREM READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'EARNPREM CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'EARNPREM ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'EARNPREM I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK.

ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE IF WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY DISPLAY 'PREMIUM INPUT OUT OF ORDER: ' PRI-POLICY-NO ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE ELSE MOVE PRI-POLICY-NO TO WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY END-IF END-IF END-READ END-IF.

WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PREMIUM-POLICY
WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12
WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO
